parse.title: Rum Deal/Quick guide
parse.wikitext:
===Finishing up===
{{Checklist|
*Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*Collect some 'Unsanitary Swill' from the output tap (south end of the brewing machine) using the bucket used for the stagnant water. (if you dropped the first one, he will give you a second one here)
*Give it to [[Captain Donnie]] outside, amongst the protesters.
*Talk to Captain Braindeath.
*'''Congratulations, quest complete!'''
}}
